tools.description:
# Tool discovery

Searches over deferred tool metadata with BM25 and exposes matching tools for the next model call.

You have access to tools from the following sources:
- Dynamic tools
- Multi-agent tools
- sqlcl
- synaroute
For MCP tool discovery, always use `tool_search`.

limit.description: Maximum number of tools to return. Defaults to 8.

arguments.query: synaroute_ai multi-model consultation route prompt category codex

tools.name: synaroute_ai
tools.description: 调用 SynaRoute 多模型大脑聚合：多个模型并行回答同一个问题，再由决策者综合出一份高质量答案。

category.description: 使用哪个分类下配置的 Key 池与聚合设置，省略默认 claude-cli

cwd.description: 可选：当前项目根目录的绝对路径。

languageHint.description: 回答语言提示，如 zh / en，省略则跟随 prompt 语言

prompt.description: 要交给多模型会诊的问题或任务。
